music: Minimal modern electronic underscore for a short tech explainer. Soft pulsing synth arpeggio, warm analog pads, a light kick and hi-hat entering after four seconds, steady 112 BPM, curious and optimistic, builds gently, resolves cleanly at the end. Instrumental, no vocals.

lines.text: Spidermonkey. A System 1 for coding agents.
A coding agent works one step at a time.
But a computer is live and chaotic, and every tool call adds to it.
Polling all of it would eat every step the agent has.
Like a brain, Spidermonkey uses a System 1 to find order in the chaos.
It steers the agent’s attention to what matters.
An interrupt when it’s stuck. A note on its next result.
Spidermonkey. Always-on System 1 for coding agents.
